body:
Reported Player(s): SharkJaws
Rules Broken: Being very rude. (Violates A1)
Evidence: Imgur Link

A player was saying that he was lagging a little bit. The player did not appear to be very annoying, as the player and I was conversing upon what was probably causing the lag he was experiencing. Unfortunately, someone appeared to be annoyed by what he did (probably because of his rage previously due to unknown causes), so he said the things he said in the Imgur link.
